COMPOSITION CONTROLS

SPACEPlay / stop
A–KPerform / record
1–4Select track
CTRL/CMD KCommand palette
SHIFT FToggle Focus mode
SHIFT G / A / PForge / Arrange / Perform
SHIFT N / DNew / duplicate clip
SHIFT S / MSolo / mute active track
SHIFT V / QMutate / quantize
CTRL/CMD ZUndo / redo
SHIFT + CLICKMulti-select notes
CTRL/CMD ASelect all notes
ARROWSMove selected notes
ALT + ARROWSResize selected notes
CTRL/CMD C / VCopy / paste notes
DELETEDelete selection

Drag notes to move them and use the handle on their right edge to resize. Web MIDI records note-on/off, velocity, bend, pressure and timbre.
